text:
maria: Quick sync — I pushed a first-pass SI enablement plan to the drive. Need rapid feedback before we share with the SI leads.
lee: Thanks Maria. Can you call out dependencies with marketplace and hardware partners? We should avoid promising features we can't list or validate in cloud marketplaces.
jamal: From SE side: must include a dev tenant + sample integration (Webhook -> Redwood API) and an automated test harness. Otherwise SIs won't be able to demo reliably.
sophia: I think we should define 3 cert levels: "Integrator", "Advanced Integrator", "Partner Engineer". Each level = hands-on lab + open-book exam + 1 reference deployment review. Badges + co-branding kit for marketing.
anita: DevEx note: I'll create 4 short lab modules (quickstart, embeddings, reranking, and deployment/ops). Prefer self-serve LMS + one proctored capstone for certs. Also propose a lightweight CI check sample:

```
# sample smoke test
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-1", "input":"hello"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
# assert 200 && contains("hello")
```

lee: For hardware partners (NVIDIA, Lambda, CoreWeave), we need a validation checklist (GPU driver, CUDA, nv_peer_mem, network egress rules) and a lab image they can boot. Also ask them for partner lab credits for SI workshops.
maria: Good point. I'll add a hardware validation page and link to partner lab offer. Timeline suggestion: share draft with SI leads by next Wed (first_message_ts + 6d), run a kickoff workshop 3 weeks after that, pilot cert cohort in week 6.
jamal: Access ops: who will own dev tenant provisioning? Need a small playbook for service accounts, scopes, and KMS access. Security should sign off on HSM/KMS steps for private deployments.
sophia: Scoring idea for certs: 50% labs, 30% deployment review, 20% exam. Keep the exam short (30 mins) with scenario-based prompts.
anita: I'll scaffold the LMS course this week. Request: share a minimal model pack (sample config + quant profiles) and 2 reference prompts so labs are deterministic. I can wire the CI smoke tests and badge issuance via API.
marketplace-bot: Link: https://docs.redwood.com/partner/marketplace-staging — marketplace listing template & required artifacts (legal, icons, pricing) updated.
lee: Also need an internal escalation path if an SI hits a blocker on hardware compatibility during certification. Suggest a single-threaded contact: jamal -> infra-support -> partner-eng.
maria: Assignments: anita -> labs + LMS; jamal -> dev tenant + automation; lee -> hardware validation & partner credits; sophia -> cert rubric & co-branding; maria -> overall program owner + announcement plan.
maria: Joint announcement planning: prefer a soft announcement (blog + joint webinar) only after 3 SIs complete pilot. For marketplace we list "Certified SI" badge. Coordinate dates with marketing.
jamal: Question: will certified status get marketplace visibility (tag/search sortable)? If yes we need metadata fields in the listing (cert_level, cert_date, cert_id).
lee: Marketplace API can accept tags; we'll need to add cert metadata to the listing. I'll loop in marketplace eng.
sophia: UX note: include a "verify cert" URL so customers can confirm the SI's certification. Also prepare an email template for customers introducing certified SIs.
marketplace-bot: FYI: marketplace staging supports custom metadata: key/values are free-form strings. See docs link above.
maria: OK next steps — I'll consolidate feedback and post an updated playbook by EOD Friday. Please react with :thumbsup: if you agree to the assignments or reply with conflicts. Thanks all! :rocket:"
